24.original: Rescue the hot-headed Kojin on the Isle of Zekki.

48.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, we have a situation! A band of Red have made off with merchandise due to be delivered to Kokajiya...and that isn't the worst of it.

49.original: Seeking to reclaim the stolen articles, one of our hot-headed brothers struck out for the Isle of Zekki, but he is slow to return. I fear for his life. Please, find him and bring him back safely!

51.original: You will pay for your trespass!

53.original: Y-You are of the Divine Circle? My thanks!

54.original: Were it not for your timely intervention, our merchandise would have been lost, never mind my life. But come, let us quit this place ere more Red appear.

55.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, pleased am I to see you hale and whole. Our hot-headed brother, too, returned a short while ago, none the worse for his ill-conceived foray, and with the merchandise intact.

56.original: While it is enough that none of us came to harm, I am grateful that we will be able to fulfill our trade obligations. You have my humblest thanks.
